documents.title: Lafayette County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 30 pages. Amounts are the Budget (p.3 Revenue/Budget Comparison 2026) and Exhibit A '2026_Budget' department Expense Totals column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
